title: Malmgren's research on Thomas Townsend Brown and time travel

tellings.quote: Harold said he was engaged in deep research around the mid-century anti-gravity inventor Thomas Townsen Brown.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Harald Malmgren, a former adviser to American presidents, told him he had done deep research on Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor of the mid-1900s who worked on anti-gravity, meaning machines meant to cancel out the pull of gravity. The story ties this research to the idea of time travel, but the telling gives no details. If true, it would mean someone close to the top of government took these ideas seriously.
